_about: Seven of the 38 MBBS 'none' decisions of 2026-10-20 that the data now holds: colleges NMC permitted in 2026 whose MBBS seats were in no counselling list then, and are in MCC's NEET UG 2026 results imported on 2026-11-09 (scripts/ug/import_mcc_ug.mjs). Each pair checked by name, place and state against the NMC register entry (all seven: inception 2026). Plus Raja Rajeshwari (Girls), Telangana, which NMC added after 2026-10-20. The 'admin-none' ug row for each code is removed when the pair is applied. AIIMS and JIPMER are not in NMC's register (they are institutes under their own Acts), so their pages stay without an NMC record by design.

AP/039/G/1: Government Medical College, Piduguralla (NMC, 2026, 50 seats) = our 'Government Medical College & General Hospital, Piduguralla', Andhra Pradesh
CG/016/G/1: Government Medical College Dantewada (NMC, 2026, 50 seats) = our 'Government Medical College, Dantewada (GMC Dantewada)', Chhattisgarh
CG/017/G/1: Government Medical College Janjgir - Champa (NMC, 2026, 50 seats) = our 'Government Medical College, Janjgir-Champa', Chhattisgarh
CG/018/G/1: Government medical college, jashpur-kunkuri (NMC, 2026, 50 seats) = our 'Government Medical College, Jashpur-Kunkuri', Chhattisgarh
CG/019/G/1: Govt. Medical College Kabirdham (NMC, 2026, 50 seats) = our 'Government Medical College, Kabirdham (Kawardha)', Chhattisgarh
CG/020/G/1: Govt.Medical Collage Manendragarh (NMC, 2026, 50 seats) = our 'Government Medical College, Manendragarh', Chhattisgarh
KA/074/P/2: Chettinad Institute of Medical Education and Research (NMC, Karnataka, 2026, 100 seats) = our 'Chettinad Institute of Medical Education & Research', Karnataka
TS/066/P/4: RAJA RAJESHWARI INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES-GIRLS (NMC, Telangana, 2026) = our 'Raja Rajeshwari Institute of Medical Sciences (Girls)', Telangana — the one NMC MBBS college still unmatched after the seven above
